thread:
Iliana Park: Quick heads-up 1: were shipping the community-localization bundle v0.1.0 today — includes Spanish and pt-BR quickstarts, localized starter templates, and a translated maintainers checklist. Release page: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-locales/releases/tag/v0.1.0 :tada:
open-source-bot: Release published: community-locales v0.1.0  assets: localized-quickstarts.zip, templates-es.zip, templates-pt-BR.zip
Samir Gupta: Incredible work, squad! Big thanks to everyone who chipped in :heartpulse: tagging i18n maintainers @Cheng @Elaine
Cheng Li: Spanish is fully translated. pt-BR still has several placeholder strings (see docs/pt-BR/* TODO). I'll open a tiny PR tonight to address them.
Elaine Ramos: I'll wire up website routes for /docs/es and /docs/pt-BR and deploy to staging after the PR lands.
Mike O'Connor: Kicking off smoke tests against the localized templates now. Posting failures here if any.
Samir Gupta: Also generating contributor credits: `python scripts/generate_credits.py --since 2024-06-01 --output credits/locales-v0.1.0.md`
Iliana Park: Heads-up: added an i18n section to the maintainers' handbook and updated CODEOWNERS for locales/. Please review when you have a minute.
Cheng Li: PR #412 opened with placeholder fixes + copy touchups. Added a small eval prompt set for es to check localized example quality.
open-source-bot: CI results: build: SUCCESS, lint: SUCCESS, i18n-smoke-tests: SUCCESS  artifacts attached.
Mike O'Connor: Smoke test found template-render failure in templates-es header component. Logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1799998888/logs. Pushing a fix branch now.
Iliana Park: Assigning @Mike O'Connor and @Cheng Li to investigate. Hosting a 30-minute i18n office hours tomorrow 16:00 UTC to triage any outstanding issues; invite to follow.
Samir Gupta: I'll invite core-maintainers + #community-contributors and prep a short walkthrough video for maintainers and volunteers.
Elaine Ramos: Suggest adding a "How to volunteer to translate" blurb in release notes. I can draft a 2-paragraph guide and CONTRIBUTING additions.
Iliana Park: Please add the draft to /docs/community/locales/README.md and ping me. I'll also draft a short blog post for next week highlighting contributors and linking to the release.
Samir Gupta: :party_parrot: Really proud of this first release wave. Nice momentum!
Mike O'Connor: Patch merged, re-running smoke tests. Will report back when staging completes.
Cheng Li: Note in PR about pluralization edge-cases for pt-BR; would appreciate native speaker review when available.
Iliana Park: Noted. We'll add a volunteer tag in the release notes and the repo issue template so native speakers can follow up. Moving ongoing troubleshooting to #eng-infra and #eng-ml. Closing thread for announcement updates.
